responsibility: This implementation module realizes the Logitech-compatible byte-level bit toolkit for GNU Modula-2. It converts BYTE values through SYSTEM.BITSET8 and CARDINAL8 representations and implements field extraction/insertion, logical AND/OR/XOR/NOT, logical and arithmetic shifts, rotates via SYSTEM.ROTATE, and nibble manipulation routines, producing transformed BYTE values or updating a caller-supplied byte in place.
same_name_distinction: This file is the implementation module for BitByteOps: unlike BitByteOps.def, it realizes the declared BYTE operations with BITSET8/CARDINAL8 conversions and SYSTEM SHIFT/ROTATE code.
